The waiver wire has been strong for weeks, and that is going to make a lot of people too aggressive with their Week 6 claims. There are 2 or 3 names worth a real bid and a few defenses worth streaming, but most of the other popular pickups are traps, so the Don’t Chase list below matters as much as the adds.

ADD #1
With David Montgomery week to week, Marks is Houston’s starter until the Week 8 bye

Marks is the most obvious add on the wire. In deeper formats he was probably drafted, but in a shallower format there is a good chance he is sitting on waivers, and if he is, go get him. Montgomery hurt his groin in Week 5, DeMeco Ryans called it week to week, and Marks took over the backfield once Montgomery left the game.
Keep the expectations to 2 weeks. Houston plays Jacksonville in Week 6 against a good defense, so I see him as a low end RB2 off volume rather than a top 20 back. The Giants follow in Week 7, then the Week 8 bye. After the bye I expect Montgomery back and a committee where nobody is startable. As a rookie, Marks was Houston’s main back from Week 3 through Week 14. In those 11 games he had 4 with 15 or more points and only 1 with 20 or more, so this is a bet on volume, not a breakout.

Bernard, Pittsburgh’s second round pick, moved into a bigger role in Week 5 with Pittman out and led the team in targets. Aaron Rodgers went out of his way to praise him after the game. With Rodgers, being on the same page with your quarterback matters more than usual, and it sounds like they are.
In deeper formats, he is worth a claim and a flex start while the byes stack up, and I may bid on him in my own league. In a shallower format I would pass. DK Metcalf is averaging under 10 points per game as the top receiver in this offense, so it does not support several fantasy receivers. I do not see Bernard turning into a league winner.

Freiermuth is the cheaper version of the Bernard claim, and I see them as the same play, so I will probably bid on both to fill my second flex spot. He is averaging 12 points per game, but he is running hot on touchdowns, with 4 on 26 targets, and that pace does not last.
For him to stay useful, the targets have to climb, and with Pittman on injured reserve and Wilson expected to miss multiple weeks, they have a real chance to. Treat him as a fill in for the next couple of weeks, not a weekly starter.

DEEPER LEAGUES
Dameon Pierce  RB · PHI
Week 5 at JAX: 11 carries · 14 rushing yards · 5 targets · 3.2 PPR
Only a play if Saquon Barkley misses Week 6, and the Eagles are hopeful he will not. Will Shipley partially tore his plantar fascia and Tank Bigsby is on injured reserve, so Pierce would start against Carolina. In an Eagles offense that projects below average even in a good matchup, he is a 1 week fill in at best.
Xavier Worthy  WR · KC
Week 5: bye
Worth a look only if he was dropped in your league and Rashee Rice misses Week 6 with his hamstring injury. With Tyquan Thornton out for months, Kansas City needs someone to throw to. Worthy has not topped 15 points in a game since Week 4 of last season, though, so this is a bet on volume, not on him.
Quentin Johnston  WR · LAC
Week 5: did not play
Also worth a look if a leaguemate dropped him. With Ladd McConkey, Tre Harris and the tight ends all banged up, he is close to the last receiver standing for the Chargers. He has not scored 8 points in a game this season, though, and he is still managing the chest injury that kept him out of Week 5.
DON’T CHASE
Raheim Sanders  RB · CLE
Week 5 at NYJ: 3 carries · 12 rushing yards · 1 target · 2.3 PPR
Quinshon Judkins left Week 5 in a walking boot, but he is listed as day to day, and Cleveland may open Dylan Sampson’s practice window. Sanders also left that game with a hip injury, so even if Judkins sits, he is a 1 week fill in for an offense you do not want any part of.
MarShawn Lloyd  RB · GB
Week 5 vs CHI: 10 carries · 31 rushing yards · 2 targets · 16.7 PPR
The 2 rushing touchdowns will get him claimed somewhere, but he played under half the snaps for the 4th time in 5 games and is averaging 2.8 yards per carry and 2 receptions per game. In deeper formats he is a desperation start against Dallas, nothing more.
Samaje Perine  RB · CIN
Week 5 at MIA: 14 carries · 68 rushing yards · 2 targets · 15.8 PPR
He scored and led Cincinnati in carries, but he is 31, has never averaged 10 points per game in a season, and the Bengals are on bye in Week 6. It is still Chase Brown’s backfield, so Perine is only worth a claim if Brown gets hurt.
Kendrick Bourne  WR · ARI
Week 5 vs DET: 8 targets · 5 receptions · 70 yards · 12.0 PPR
The Marvin Harrison Jr. trade to Houston has people excited about him, but he played under half of Arizona’s snaps against Detroit. He has been in the league since 2017 and has never finished a season as a top 30 receiver in points per game.
QUARTERBACK STREAMERS
Jordan Love  QB · GB
Week 5 vs CHI: 367 passing yards · 2 passing TDs · 6 rushing yards · 25.3 PPR
If you lost Jared Goff to the Lions’ bye, Love is the stream. Green Bay hosts Dallas, which has one of the worst defenses in the league, and the Packers project as one of the highest scoring offenses of Week 6.
Tyler Shough  QB · NO
Week 5 vs MIN: 96 passing yards · 0 passing TDs · 0 rushing yards · -0.2 PPR
Probably not on your wire, but if a frustrated leaguemate dropped him after the Minnesota game, pick him up. That was one of the worst matchups a quarterback can draw, and New Orleans gets a bounce back spot against the Giants in Week 6.
DEFENSES TO STREAM
My pick: Chiefs vs Chargers
There is a good chance Kansas City was dropped in your league during its Week 5 bye, and the winless Chargers, with injuries everywhere, project as the lowest scoring offense of Week 6. I have an aggressive bid in on the Chiefs.
Also in play
Ravens at Browns · Colts vs Titans · Patriots vs Jets · Steelers at Buccaneers
How I pick them
I stream defenses off the betting markets: the biggest favorites against the offenses projected to score the fewest points. My bids are in for the Chiefs, Ravens and Colts, in that order, because the Steelers and Seahawks are already rostered in my league.
